implementation.framework: Explicit validated Alpha8 storage and format-aware mip reduction; R8 textures reconstruct premultiplied white before tint/opacity; text retains 2x supersampling with one coverage channel.
implementation.client: NativeAssets prepares bundled theme-tinted artwork as masks; colored XDG icons and wallpapers remain RGBA. Domain/port responsibilities unchanged.
implementation.allocation: The shared Vulkan device requests wgpu MemoryHints::MemoryUsage; a supported allocation preference, not a cap or a guaranteed backend behavior.
implementation.compatibility: Pre-release ImageLevel.rgba field renamed pixels; consult ImageData.format() for packed storage.

validation.full_visual_driver_scope: All 248 comparisons on the final allocation checkpoint pass on hardware locally and software in GitHub CI. The mask checkpoint also passed both drivers locally.
validation.gpu_scope: Exact mask/RGBA pixels at 1x/2x with tint/opacity/fractional geometry/mips; warm upload accounting, cross-surface resource lifecycle and invalid scene/extent rejection on both drivers.
validation.core_ci: All six checks passed for source commit 3412d44a6080692391734fde8f608266f086cd02; final evidence-head CI tracked on PR #36.

comparison.scope: Sequential 120-second warm single-output software-Vulkan VM samples on a shared host; current release restored and its running hash verified after the baseline. No CPU or hardware frame-pacing improvement is claimed. RSS includes mapped driver/software-GPU pages; total GPU memory was not measured.

earlier_observations.interpretation: Payload savings alone did not prove lower average RSS in the first pair. A same-boot comparison then showed a modest reduction; the final record includes the supported allocation preference as a second change.

deployment: Atomic desktop-only install with verified hashes and preserved rollback copies; CLI, integration scripts and secure lock/login binaries unchanged. Native tests restore preferences, wallpaper, output and idle state.
pending: Review and merging the stacked PRs; CI status is tracked on PR #36. No automatic merge.

RSS below 200 MiB is not established for all workloads; active overlay/decode peaks, allocator/driver retention, actual GPU allocations, hardware frame pacing, long idle and fault recovery remain open.
Physical networking, secret-agent/enterprise/WEP/VPN, captive portals, suspend/hotplug and native Bluetooth/battery/brightness/power/audio-card/tray acceptance remain unfinished.
Per-output selection/layout, fractional scale, text shaping/fallback/IME/grapheme/caret/selection/clipboard/accessibility/touch and virtualized/kinetic/horizontal scrolling remain open.
Live application discovery, dock persistence/reorder/auto-hide, widget resize/output/z-order/data, rich/grouped/persistent notifications and full settings/packaging/migration/rollback remain open.
Secure lock/login build alignment and retest, including the recorded username ClearInput bug, remain separate work.
